description:
Hushfacebook v0.3.4 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release includes all changes since v0.2.0. There are 43 patches in all, up from 27: searchable settings, Marketplace only, chosen startup tabs, more feed and ad controls, custom font files, promotional notification filters, comment order and explicit @ tag suggestions.

Tap to play clears the initial Reels play overlay during playback and prevents rapid swipes from reusing a tap. Compatible saves keep known H.264/AAC pairs, and sound selection favors formats more players can handle. Marketplace only starts off and has an action to restore regular Facebook navigation.

Validation: 984 runtime tests passed locally. All 454 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 43 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72; resource and injected-code checks passed.

Some device-specific reports remain under investigation, including WhatsApp import, Xiaomi Gallery audio, Media settings, cloned-app settings and a missing Reel Download button. Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, build 475019344, or 577.0.0.50.72, build 474426275. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
